violations.description: CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Food noted being stored on an absorbant surface in kitchen on the rolling prep cart. Towels and/or absorbent surfaces should not be used under food utensils or food contact surfaces. | CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Raw tuna noted stored in cut vacuum sealed bag. Raw seafood and fish must be completely removed from the vacuum packaging when removed from the freezer to thaw or store under refrigeration.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - DESIGN (1 pts): Door gasket on the tall reach-in freezer/cooler noted not in good repair.
IN-USE UTENSILS (1 pts): In - use utensil (scoop) noted being stored with the handle laying in the sugar.
IN-USE UTENSILS (1 pts): In - use utensil noted being stored with the handle laying in the cashews and rice.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (1 pts): Sliding door tracks of reach-in coolers noted not clean.
